title: ligularia sibirica subsp. lydiae
intro: Ligularia sibirica subsp. lydiae, commonly known as Russian Ligularia, is a flowering plant species in the daisy family. This plant is valued for its medicinal properties and is used in traditional medicine to treat various health issues. The health benefits of Russian Ligularia include anti-inflammatory and antioxidant effects, which can help to reduce pain and inflammation, as well as protect against cell damage. The therapeutic actions of this plant include analgesic, anti-inflammatory, and antiseptic properties, which can be attributed to its bioactive constituents such as sesquiterpenes, flavonoids, and phenolic acids.
